{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Cerise Island |characters=スオウ島 |japanese=Suō Island |image=Cerise Island.png |caption=Cerise Island as seen in Pokémon Adventures |region=Kanto |epicode=PS053 |episode=Can't Catch Caterpie! |colorscheme=Yellow}} '''Cerise Island''' (Japanese: '''スオウ島''' ''Suō Island'') is a location in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It is located somewhere to the west of [[Cinnabar Island]]. The island is unmapped and almost unknown. There is also a dormant volcano inside of it. It is called a "gigantic badge energy amplifier" by [[Lance]] as with seven of the Badges located around the perimeter of the island under its rock spires and the {{badge|Earth}} in the center of the island over the volcano, it performs the same function as the device used by [[Team Rocket]], but on a much grander scale. It was the headquarters of the [[Elite Four]] during the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}, whose plans were to decimate the entire human race save for themselves and their allied {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. They felt that humans were destroying Pokémon and only by killing all humans could the Pokémon be saved. Cerise Island appears in the Pokémon Adventures manga, volumes 4-7, where {{adv|Yellow}}, {{adv|Bill}}, {{adv|Blue}}, {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Red}}, [[Koga]], [[Sabrina]], and [[Lt. Surge]] {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Lance]], [[Agatha]], [[Bruno]], and [[Lorelei]] in order to save the human race. {{p|Lugia}} also makes an appearance above Cerise Island.
